title: Failure: date_diff missing start or end date column
description: A date_diff step requires explicit start_column and end_column values that both exist in the active dataset.
planner_guidance: When the request says 'duration' or 'days between' but does not identify both date columns, ask which columns should be used.

example.problem: The request does not say which columns represent order date and delivery date.
example.resolution: Ask the user to choose start and end columns before generating date_diff.

rag_note: Do not guess date_diff columns from names unless the dataset schema makes the user's intent explicit.
